text: By the destruction of the impressions (samskaras) produced by dharma and adharma, and upon the attainment of the dissolution of the body, the purpose of the Pradhana being fulfilled, it ceases. Thereupon, he attains absolute, final, and eternal Kaivalya (isolation), which is free from any subsequent state. This is called Moksha (liberation) because it is the state of pure isolation (Kevalabhava). Thus, he attains the specific Kaivalya that is both absolute and final.
